name: Personalized Wooden House Shape 3D Christmas Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 3mm Wooden panels assembled into a unique 3D house-shaped ornament with realistic depth and dimension.
    - Features a multi-panel construction with 2-sided printing on every panel, creating a beautifully detailed ornament viewable from every angle - front, back, sides, and top.
    - All panels are precision laser-cut and slot together for a sturdy, seamless structure.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

       - Overall: 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
            +) Depth (top): 2.7 cm ~ 1.06 in
            +)Depth (bottom): 2.3 cm ~ 0.91 in
📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Features high-quality UV printing for clear, vibrant, and detailed personalized artwork on all panels.
    - Every panel is printed on both sides for a complete, polished look from any viewing angle.
    - Produced using precision laser cutting for smooth edges and clean custom silhouette shapes.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom 3D hanging ornament for Christmas trees, room décor, holiday displays, and seasonal keepsakes.
    - Suitable for personalization with family names, member names, dates, and festive artwork.
    - The 3D house-shaped construction creates a miniature scene effect, adding depth and charm compared to traditional flat ornaments.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-lasting decorative use.
    - Easy to hang with the included hanging accessories.
    - Perfect for themed designs such as first Christmas in a new home, family keepsakes, and holiday celebrations.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for families, couples, new homeowners, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, housewarming celebrations, family milestones, and holiday occasions.
    - Great for creating custom ornaments with family names, meaningful messages, and festive decorative details.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake that stands out with its unique 3D house-shaped design and warm natural wood craftsmanship.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
